admissions_final_enrolment.purpose: Forecast final enrolment and seat-fill probability per programme during the admission cycle
admissions_final_enrolment.owner: Head of Admissions (business) / APEX analytics lead (technical)
admissions_final_enrolment.target: max enrolled_cum at end of cycle (week 26)
admissions_final_enrolment.training: all completed cycles before the forecast year (snapshot-gated)
admissions_final_enrolment.limitations: No external drivers yet (competitor fees, counselling dates, BSCC approvals). Synthetic demo data only.
admissions_final_enrolment.fairness_review: Programme-level aggregate model; no individual-level predictions, so no cohort fairness exposure.
